check.prompt: What is a layer in a layered architecture?
options: A group of related code that only talks to the layer below it
A coat of paint on the user interface
A backup copy of the database
check.explanation: Layers group code by role, and limiting who talks to whom keeps dependencies under control.
check.hint: Look at the picture: who talks to whom?

options: Parts depend on each other as little as possible
Every part depends on every other part
check.explanation: Low coupling means a change in one part rarely forces changes in others.
check.hint: Coupling is about how tightly parts are tied together.

options: The contents of a part belong together and serve one purpose
The part is copied in many places
check.explanation: A cohesive part has one clear purpose, so it is easier to understand, test and reuse.
check.hint: Think of how well a part's contents fit together.
